episodes.title: Plutonium
episodes.summary: As a new year begins at Boring High School, freshman Luke impresses his friends by inviting sophomore Kate -- the principal's daughter -- to his house.

episodes.title: Maybe You're Gonna Be the One That Saves Me
episodes.summary: Luke plans his next move with Kate, who's having a rough day at school, and discovers VHS tapes that bring back emotional memories.

episodes.title: All That and a Bag of Chips
episodes.summary: A pulled fire alarm lands Luke in detention and his mother in Ken's office. The irate drama club plots revenge on the AV kids.

episodes.title: Romeo & Juliet in Space
episodes.summary: Luke presents a proposal to the drama club in an effort to make peace. Sherry and Ken engage in some impromptu immature behavior.

episodes.title: What the Hell's a Zarginda?
episodes.summary: Luke tries to help Kate work through her feelings. Oliver and Luke hold film auditions. Emaline takes Kate shopping. Ken invites Luke over for dinner.

episodes.title: Sometimes I Hear My Voice
episodes.summary: Luke and Kate attempt to get to Portland for a concert. Ken and Sherry partake in contraband that was confiscated from a student.

episodes.title: Cheesecake to a Fat Man
episodes.summary: Luke wallows in anger, while Ken and Kate bask in liberation. Tyler's proficiency with dial-up internet leads to unusual drug experimentation.

episodes.title: I Just Wanna Be Anybody
episodes.summary: The Boring High crew takes an emotionally exhausting trip to California to shoot a scene for the movie ... minus one important member.

episodes.title: My Friends Have Been Eaten by Spiders
episodes.summary: An exasperated Luke scrambles to finish the movie. Kate has important conversations with Emaline and Luke. McQuaid gets a sudden boost of confidence.

episodes.title: We Were Merely Freshmen
episodes.summary: The Boring community comes together for the movie premiere, where angst simmers even as wounds heal and relationships blossom.
